programs.title: Howl's Moving Castle
programs.desc: Young Sophie is eighteen, and works tirelessly every day making hats in the shop once owned by her deceased father. On a rare outing to town, Sophie accidentally encounters the wizard Howl. Howl is dashing, terribly handsome, yet as wizards go, he’s a bit of a wimp. They are spotted by the Witch of the Waste, who mistakes the nature of the relationship between them. Seized by jealousy, she casts a spell on Sophie, transforming her into a withered ninety-year-old woman.

programs.title: Vai
programs.desc: Vai is a film about female empowerment telling the story of one woman's life in eight separate moments from the perspective of eight different Pacific Island cultures. Beautifully shot, celebratory and epic, at times heartbreaking and uplifting, Vai is a seamless portmanteau film directed by eight female Pacific directors.

programs.title: Oskars Kleid
programs.desc: Ben has been separated from his ex-wife and their children Oskar and Erna. But his kids suddenly live with him again and they stumble into an adventure when son Oskar starts wearing a dress that he no longer wants to take off.

programs.title: Close
programs.desc: The intense friendship between two thirteen-year old boys Leo and Remi suddenly gets disrupted. Struggling to understand what has happened, Léo approaches Sophie, Rémi's mother. \.

programs.title: Thunderbirds Are Go
programs.desc: When the launch of a mission to Mars goes awry due to sabotage, International Rescue is requested to assist in the mission's second attempt.

programs.title: Delfin
programs.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin, an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small town outside of Buenos Aires. Delfin's ambition is to join a children's orchestra in a neighbouring village.
